notes.title: THE FINAL UPDATE + WHAT NOW!?
notes.content: [h3]Greetings,[/h3][p][/p][p]Well, this is it, my final update for this game! It has been a pleasure to work on this game, but do not fret, as I will still be making games in the future. After working on this game for about a year now, from its early access phase (which was pretty bare bones at that point) to a fully finished game! I couldn't have done it without some of the people helping me work on this project; my dream game wouldn't be the same without them! [/p][p][/p][h3]What's new? [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed player breathing (sprinting works now)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the AI to have breathing as well (including footsteps) [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]So What Now!?[/h3][p]I am going to plan out a new game idea, and maybe some other projects that do not have anything to do with video games. Nonetheless, another project will be a game, but who knows how long it will take? I will not do another early access phase for my next game; I have learned my lesson from this one. If I do decide to make it into early access, I'll be sure to have a lot more stuff in the game than having it bare bones and empty with barely any features. If you'd like to keep up to date, make sure to follow me on my Twitter/X page, I'm more active there than anywhere else, to be honest! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you, everyone, for those who kept in check when the game was still in its infancy, and for those who are new to my game and want to try it out! My journey of game development is only the beginning of what is to come![/p][p][/p][p]God bless you all![/p][p]~HBunny[/p]

notes.title: Major Update OUT NOW & MORE!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, everyone! [/h2]

It has been a while since my last post here. Well, the wait is finally over! Anomalous Deception [u][b]UPDATE VERSION 3[/b][/u] is now finally out! This also means the game is now in [i][b]FULL RELEASE![/b][/i] 

This does not mean that I am completely done with the game; there are still a few small things that I need to patch up before I fully move on to another project. The game is 100% complete with some minor bugs that won't interrupt the gameplay experience. 

Here's what's new on this update! 

[h3]Added: [/h3]
-Additional Level Generation
-AI Monster In That Said Level Generation
-UI interaction indicator
-More Collectibles (AKA Documents for the lore!)
-A Gun (Only For that Said Level Generation)
-Randomize Puzzles (Only For That Said Level)
-Two More Endings (Which will surprise you!)
-An End Credits 

[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
-Difficulty Balance

[h3]Removed: [/h3]
-Early Access Popup (From Main Menu)
-Launcher

I do plan to polish up the game once more, then it'll be another project, for which I have some ideas in mind! I can't say what it's going to be, but I do kinda want to make a story-focused type of gameplay like how SOMA does it. 

We will see what the future holds, but until then, enjoy this game in all its glory!

~HBunny

notes.title: Upcoming Major Update In The Future!
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone! 

I figured I should inform you of the next big update I plan to release soon. Hopefully. 

This upcoming major update will help finalize the game to be 100% complete!

I plan to add randomly generated puzzles for the game, including an extra randomized level as well! each room will serve its purpose for the player to complete the level, I have thoughts on adding a [u][b]self-defense[/b][/u] weapon for specifically that extra level I plan to add. 

Here's a preview of one of the puzzles I plan to add! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964787/7123f481dc1b3da5f760b6a3895d814c5060844f.gif[/img]

I also plan to update the interaction system a little bit, kinda like almost "amnesia/soma" kind of interactivity. Not much is promised but it will be planned to be added! 

I still plan to add the last two endings which will be made! 

I do plan to add more lore to the game which will vary on your completion of the gameplay. You'll like it since it tells more about the story. 

More will be opened up later on but for now, I'll keep my peace!

~HBunny

notes.title: Added A Launcher
notes.content:
Just a small unimportant update, the game hasn't changed at all just added a small and simple launcher. I still have yet to figure out a way to make the option if you want to have the launcher open first by default or the game itself. 

[h1]What does the launcher do?[/h1] 
The Steam version allows you to play the game since you as the player have already bought the game there's no need to take extra steps to unlock the game off Steam.

[h1]So the launcher is for people who bought it off Steam?[/h1] 
It's more of a brand I'm trying to expand upon but not like those [spoiler]AAA studios who take advantage of their customers with their launcher[/spoiler]. 

[h1]How far will this launcher go?[/h1] 
Depends on how much I enjoy this idea and proceed with more ideas that can be useful for more people on my games! 

Honestly, I am quite enjoying it and want to do more with these kinds of creativity. 

~HBunny | [url=https://x.com/HBunnyBoi]Twitter/X[/url] | [url=https://www.youtube.com/@HBunny]Youtube[/url]
